<!-- pr-reviewer: 687ac49fe22fd6dcee3cb18a58ce8fc8f9f81369 -->
Needs changes before merge.

The selected tests pass. One code placement rule needs a correction.

What looks good:
- The three pocket operations generate cuts within the selected walls.
- A kept part in the cutting path causes a gouge warning and blocks posting.
- The diff changes no goldens, UI files, dependencies, or build scripts.

Local results:
- Reviewed head: `687ac49fe22fd6dcee3cb18a58ce8fc8f9f81369`.
- Trial merge base: upstream/main at `db091cb38163f3713ce44918ea973855cd0960ad`. The head already contains this base.
- The selected application test targets build with `cargo test --no-run`.
- Application unit tests: 318 passed, 1 ignored.
- Integration tests: blind_slot 4, open_band 7, area_open 11, slot_caps 4, slot_extension 5, slot_pick_refusals 3, slot_picks 8. All passed.
- `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` passed.
- The quick gate dry run completed. I ran the relevant slot suites above, rather than all 204 mapped suites.

Safety mutation results:
- Disabled the parallel-end guard. `blind_slot_nonparallel_ends_and_skew_mouth_are_refused` failed because the invalid slot was accepted.
- Disabled the single-region guard. `blind_slot_split_stock_is_refused` failed because two stock regions were accepted.
- Restored the source. All five blind-slot guard tests passed. The worktree has no source changes.

Requested before merge:
1. `crates/app/src/operation/open_slot.rs:7`: Move the geometry calculation and its five unit tests to `camcraft-geometry`. Keep the application error conversion in `app`. This new module uses only points, regions, and numeric values. It does not read the ECS world, project files, commands, MCP, or CLI. AGENTS.md lines 720–727 require this code in the crate that owns these values. The existing `boundary_chains` module already provides the related split calculation. Moving the calculation also lets these guard tests run without building the application.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Fixed the requested code placement change.

- Moved the blind-slot calculation and its five unit tests to `camcraft-geometry`, under `boundary_chains::open_slot`.
- Kept the application error conversion in `app`.
- Added `blind_slot_is_a_geometry_crate_interface`. This test checks the geometry API and the selected region.
- Reverted the move for the mutation check. The new test failed to compile. Restored the move. The test and five guards passed.
- All four application `blind_slot` tests passed. Clippy passed for both changed crates, with warnings treated as errors.

`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` selected the batch checks. Nine stages passed, including clippy. The UI stage failed: `trace_composite` and `trace_parity` terminated with SIGSEGV after Mesa cache warnings.

Both failed targets passed with writable caches. From `crates/ui`:

```sh
XDG_CACHE_HOME=/tmp/fix-1841-xdg-cache MESA_SHADER_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/fix-1841-mesa-cache cargo test -j 6 -p camcraft-ui --test trace_composite --test trace_parity --no-fail-fast -- --test-threads=6
```

The rerun passed all four composite tests and all five parity tests. No UI source changed.

New head: `9ee74b00a7d0552cb238e03fb7a21a490f52f56b`.

Please review the fix again.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 9ee74b00a7d0552cb238e03fb7a21a490f52f56b -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

The new head resolves the code placement finding from the previous review. No blocking items remain.

What looks good:
- The geometry crate now owns the blind-slot calculation and its five guard tests.
- The application converts geometry errors to operation errors.
- The three pocket operations keep cuts within the selected walls, with and without extension.
- A kept part in the cutting path causes a gouge warning and blocks posting. The test checks that no output file exists.
- No UI files, goldens, dependencies, or build scripts changed. No screenshot or golden comparison is required.

Local results:
- Reviewed head: `9ee74b00a7d0552cb238e03fb7a21a490f52f56b`.
- Trial merge with upstream/main at `7c514c874fbe5f381e7f41550b178adff27b80b7` succeeded.
- The selected application test targets built with `cargo test --no-run`.
- Application unit tests: 313 passed, 1 ignored.
- Application integration tests: blind_slot 4, open_band 7, area_open 11, slot_caps 4, slot_extension 5, slot_pick_refusals 3, slot_picks 8. All passed.
- Full geometry suite: 94 passed. This includes the two boundary_chains interface tests and five blind-slot guard tests.
- `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-geometry --all-targets -- -D warnings` passed.
- The quick gate dry run passed. I ran the relevant suites listed above. I did not run the full gate or use a GitHub runner.

Safety mutation results:
- Disabled the parallel-end guard. `blind_slot_nonparallel_ends_and_skew_mouth_are_refused` failed because it accepted an invalid slot.
- Disabled the single-region guard. `blind_slot_split_stock_is_refused` failed because it accepted two stock regions.
- Restored the source after each mutation. All five guard tests then passed. No mutation remains in the worktree.

Requested before merge: none.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
